fields.description: Fixed list so /forms/user/files can group and filter by it reliably — free-form Tags below are for anything finer.
fields.label: Category
fields.options:
Compliance
Tax Form
License & Permit
Insurance
Contract
Financial Statement
Policy
Other

fields.description: The document's own date (issued, filed, covers-this-period) — not when it was uploaded here. Optional.
fields.label: Document Date

fields.description: For anything that needs renewing (licenses, insurance, tax filings). /forms/user/files flags this Expiring Soon / Expired. Leave blank for documents that never expire.
fields.label: Expiry Date

fields.description: Uploaded via /forms/user/files -- ez_accounting.www.forms.user.files.upload_document(), not this doctype's own Attach widget, so the underlying File is created with the app's own permission checks (see upload_sales_invoice_attachment's docstring for why: the desk-style /api/method/upload_file endpoint needs doctype write permission this portal role doesn't hold). Deliberately NOT `reqd` -- the record is inserted first (to get a name), then the File is created attached to it, then this field is set via db_set; upload_document() itself throws before ever inserting if no file was posted, so a record with no file is never actually reachable in practice.
fields.label: File

fields.description: MD5 checksum of the uploaded file's content, same as core File.content_hash -- used to detect whether a document (e.g. an email attachment) has already been filed here.
fields.label: MD5

fields.description: Comma-separated free text — searched alongside Title/Category/File Name on /forms/user/files. E.g. "2026, renewal, state". Small Text rather than Data deliberately -- Data columns cap at 140 characters, too short for the kind of long, detailed keyword lists AI Read tends to suggest (see the Files memory for the truncation this fixed).
fields.label: Tags

fields.description: Full text Claude extracted from the file, via the "AI Read" button on /forms/user/files -- ez_accounting.www.forms.user.files.ai_read(). Read-only: re-run AI Read to refresh it, rather than hand-editing OCR'd/extracted text.
fields.label: Extracted Content

fields.description: When checked, only the document's owner (the uploader) can see, open, edit, AI Read or delete it -- in /forms/user/finder, /forms/user/files, search, downloads and Desk. Unchecked = shared with everyone who can access the company.
fields.label: Private (owner only)
